brand.name: Brand
brand.paragraph: Defaults throughout this theme come from the Glorious design. Every value can be changed here without touching code.

wordmark.label: Wordmark letters
wordmark.info: Set as individual letters spread edge to edge in the hero and footer.

wordmark_mark.label: Wordmark centre mark
wordmark_mark.info: Optional emblem substituted for the first O.

shop.name: Shop details
shop.paragraph: Stated once and used everywhere the shop states them: the menu overlay, the footer, and the Visit section.

shop_address_link.label: Map link
shop_address_link.info: Opens in a new tab wherever the address is shown.

shop_phone.label: Telephone
shop_phone.info: Shown as written; the tel: link strips spaces and punctuation.

page_width_narrow.label: Narrow page width
page_width_narrow.info: Used by the craft and visit layouts.

grid_min_column.label: Minimum product column width
grid_min_column.info: Product grids reflow when columns would get narrower than this.

typography.name: Typography
typography.paragraph: The theme ships with Italiana and Karla self-hosted. Turn the bundled fonts off to pick from Shopify's library instead.

use_bundled_fonts.label: Use the bundled Glorious fonts
use_bundled_fonts.info: Italiana for display, Karla for body.

font_heading.label: Display font
font_heading.info: Only used when the bundled fonts are turned off.

font_body.label: Body font
font_body.info: Only used when the bundled fonts are turned off.

typography.display_paragraph: The oversized section titles that run edge to edge. These scale with the viewport rather than stepping at breakpoints.

display_grow.label: Display growth rate
display_grow.info: How fast display headings grow with screen width.

typography.micro_paragraph: The small uppercase eyebrow text above section headings and inside cards.

colors.name: Colors
colors.paragraph: Porcelain is the default page scheme. Noir carries the hero, the craft section and the footer.

accent.label: Accent
accent.info: The gold used for micro labels, rules and emblems.

error.label: Error
error.info: Used by form errors and the remove control in the bag.

shape.name: Shape
shape.paragraph: The design pairs square cards and imagery with fully rounded buttons.

radius_arch.label: Arched image radius
radius_arch.info: The tall arch on the about and visit photographs.

hairline_opacity.label: Hairline strength
hairline_opacity.info: Opacity of the thin rules that separate rows and sections.

button_radius.label: Button corner radius
button_radius.info: At the maximum the button is fully rounded into a pill, as in the design.

card_image_fit.label: Image fit
card_image_fit.info: The design shows jewellery uncropped against white.

card_show_metal.label: Show metal line
card_show_metal.info: Reads the product's Metal option or metafield when present.

card_show_swatches.label: Show metal swatches
card_show_swatches.info: A row of metals on the card. Choosing one moves the caption, the price and what goes in the bag — never the photograph, which is shot in one metal.

card_show_options_note.label: Show the options note
card_show_options_note.info: The line under the swatches listing the piece's other choices, such as gold purity.

card_show_video.label: Include the 360° spin
card_show_video.info: Adds a product video to the card as a final view.

card_image_zoom.label: Crop the photographer’s margin
card_image_zoom.info: Scales each photograph so the piece fills the frame, by category. A custom.card_zoom metafield overrides it per piece.

quick_view.name: Quick view
quick_view.paragraph: Opens over the grid from the eye on a product card, and is rendered from the product itself.
quick_view.specs_info: House-wide values. A custom.diamond_clarity_grade, custom.diamond_color_grade or custom.certification_lab metafield overrides one per piece.

show_tax_note.label: Show the tax note after prices
show_tax_note.info: The one switch for it. Every price in the theme obeys this — cards, the product page, the bag, the cart, quick view and search — and nothing can override it.

cart.name: Cart
cart.paragraph: The drawer and the cart page are alternatives, not both — whichever is chosen here is where the bag action goes.

cart_type.label: Opening the bag
cart_type.info: Without JavaScript the bag always falls back to the cart page.

cart_drawer_on_add.label: Open the drawer after adding
cart_drawer_on_add.info: Only applies while the drawer is chosen above.

cart_unit_price.label: Show the price of one
cart_unit_price.info: A line reads the price of a single piece rather than price × quantity. Applies to the bag drawer and the cart page.

cart_image_ratio.label: Image shape
cart_image_ratio.info: The frame a line’s photograph sits in, as on a product card.

localization.name: Localization
localization.paragraph: Selectors appear only when more than one country or language is published in your markets.

show_country_header.label: Show country selector in the header

show_country_footer.label: Show country selector in the footer

show_language_header.label: Show language selector in the header

show_language_footer.label: Show language selector in the footer

motion.name: Motion
motion.paragraph: Motion is disabled automatically for visitors who ask their device to reduce it.

anchor.label: Anchor
anchor.info: Lets other links jump here, e.g. /#visit. Leave empty for none.

carousel_arrows.label: Arrow position
carousel_arrows.info: Beside the row, the arrows take room from the cards, so on a narrow screen they move back under it.

carousel_motion.label: Carousel animation
carousel_motion.info: How one page gives way to the next.

full_height.label: Fill the screen height
full_height.info: The section occupies the full viewport, as in the design.

layout.label: Layout
layout.info: The grid reflows on the width it is given. The carousel shows one page of that same grid at a time.

show_all.label: Show every message at once
show_all.info: When off, only the first message is shown.

header.name: Header

nav_mode.paragraph: The design gives the homepage a floating pill and the inner pages a full bar, so the two are set separately.
nav_mode.info: Expand on scroll uses the hero title as its cue where there is one, and the distance below otherwise.
nav_mode.morph: Floating pill, expanding to a bar on scroll

scroll_threshold.label: Scroll distance before it expands
scroll_threshold.info: Only used on pages with no hero title to measure against.

overlay_home.label: Let the homepage hero sit under the bar
overlay_home.info: The bar starts transparent over the hero and turns solid on scroll. Other templates always reserve its height.

header.search_paragraph: The overlay searches as the visitor types. With it switched off the search action goes to the search page instead.

search_overlay.label: Open search as an overlay
search_overlay.info: Opens over the page, and with ⌘K, Ctrl+K or /.

search_popular.label: Popular searches
search_popular.info: Separate with commas. Shown before anything is typed.

search_collection.label: Featured pieces
search_collection.info: Shown in the overlay before anything is typed.

header.menu_paragraph: Menu rows are numbered automatically in the order they appear here. Bag and Search are added last when they are switched on above.
header.menu_address_paragraph: The address under the menu comes from Theme settings → Shop details.

menu.name: Link column
menu.actions_info: Set a link's URL to #newsletter or #cookie-preferences to make it open that overlay instead of navigating.

menu.label: Menu
menu.info: Pick a navigation menu to use instead of the links below.

contact.name: Salon details
contact.paragraph: The address, telephone and email come from Theme settings → Shop details.

hero.name: Hero

image.label: Portrait image
image.info: A dark portrait wearing the collection works best.

hero.carousel_paragraph: Add one metal per switch. Each carries its own collection, and the carousel shows two pieces at a time from whichever is selected.

collection.label: Collection
collection.info: The pieces the carousel shows while this metal is selected.

pulse.label: Pulse until a point is chosen

show_list.label: Show the piece list beside the stage

scene.name: Look

tag.label: Caption
tag.info: Shown in the corner of the stage.

video.label: Film
video.info: Used instead of the image. Plays muted and looped while the stage is on screen.

scene.points_paragraph: Place each point as a percentage across and down the stage. The seconds only apply to a film — leave them empty and the point is always shown.

limit_products.label: Limit how many products are shown
limit_products.info: Off shows the whole collection, up to the 50 Shopify returns in one page.

view_all_label.label: View all label
view_all_label.info: Leave blank to show the collection's product count.

view_all_link.label: View all link
view_all_link.info: Defaults to the collection above. Set this to send it somewhere else.

title.label: Title
title.info: Falls back to the collection title.

image.label: Image
image.info: Falls back to the collection image.

video.label: Video
video.info: Plays muted and looped. Falls back to the image when empty.

source.label: Value from
source.info: Anything but Custom takes the value, and its link, from Theme settings → Shop details.

value.label: Value
value.info: Used only when Value from is Custom.

delay.label: Delay before it appears
delay.info: Shown once per visitor until they subscribe or dismiss it. Footer links reopen it at any time.

cart_drawer.name: Bag drawer
cart_drawer.paragraph: Shown only while the cart is set to a drawer in Theme settings → Cart.

promise_label.label: Reassurance label
promise_label.info: Shown with the reassurance sentence when the tax note is on. Both are the design’s own copy.

note.label: Note when the tax note is off
note.info: Replaces the reassurance above when Theme settings → Pricing → tax note is off, because prices are then not tax-inclusive.
